name: Puppy Love 2: The Spacening
source:
The Puppy Love high school has moved into geostationary orbit for its next big adventure. (For reasons.) But something's gone very wrong, and it doesn't look like it'll stay in orbit much longer…

Our previous protagonist, Silas, will be stepping once more into the space-boots of the hero. He must unravel the mystery that threatens to destroy the whole school! But who, or what, could be responsible? Have aliens infested the station? Are pirates infiltrating the crew? Are your friends getting possessed by the vengeful spirits of the dead?

You watch the story unfold and make key choices about how Silas explores the station. But watch out - every minute that passes brings the station closer to its fiery doom!

Puppy Love II is fully twice the size (and length) of our first game, and there are a jaw-dropping nine different endings to discover! Can you get them all?

Not only are there more endings than ever, we've made the bulk of the gameplay a bit less linear, giving you more paths to explore each time you play. Can you find what happened to the goldfish? Can you find what lurks in the mysterious shuttle? Can you turn your best friend purple with the power of science?

[From [url=http://puppylovegame.tumblr.com/puppy_love_ii]official site[/url]]
translation:
早恋高中已进入地球静止轨道，开始下一次大冒险。（出于某种原因。）但是有些事情出了很大的问题，而且看起来它不会在轨道上停留太久……

我们之前的主角塞拉斯将再次踏上英雄的太空靴。他必须解开威胁整个学校的谜团！但谁或什么应该对此负责呢？外星人入侵了空间站吗？海盗是否已渗透到船员中？你的朋友是否被死者的复仇之魂附身了？

你观看故事的展开，并就塞拉斯如何探索空间站做出关键选择。但要小心——每过去一分钟，车站就离它的毁灭更近了一步！

《早恋II》的大小（和长度）是我们第一款游戏的两倍，并且有九个令人瞠目结舌的不同结局等待发现！你能把它们全部拿到吗？

不仅结局比以往更多，我们还让大部分游戏玩法变得不那么线性，让你每次玩游戏时都有更多探索路径。你能找出金鱼发生了什么吗？你能找到隐藏在神秘航天飞机中的东西吗？你能用科学的力量把你最好的朋友变成紫色吗？

[来自[url=http://puppylovegame.tumblr.com/puppy_love_ii]官方网站[/url]]
